`assertCan(actor, action, resource)` is defined in `src/lib/permissions.ts` — it wraps the boolean-returning `explain()`/`can()` decision functions and throws a `PermissionDeniedError` when the decision is not allowed. It's the only permission-check function in the codebase that throws rather than returning a boolean.

Per the architecture (documented in `scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts`), `assertCan` is meant to be called exclusively from the service layer, and that's exactly what I found: all 14 files in `src/server/services/` call it, plus two test files that call it directly to assert throw/no-throw behavior. Everywhere else (actions, components, pages, hooks) uses the boolean `can()` function instead, and a few files only mention `assertCan` in comments/strings without calling it.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/lib/permissions.ownership.test.ts
